theorems.name: Submission.dimred_tr_iterated_blowup_limit
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid P) (xs : ℕ → Euclid P) (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ i, 0 < lams i) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (y : Euclid P) (ss : ℕ → ℝ) (hss : ∀ k, 0 < ss k) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsOpen U → x ∈ U → Tendsto xs atTop (𝓝 x) → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto ss atTop (𝓝 0) → (∃ δ Γ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x' ∈ ball x δ, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < δ → T.massOn (ball x' ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Γ * ρ ^ n)) → ConvergesWeakly (fun i => blowUp T (xs i) (lams i) (hlams i).ne') S → ConvergesWeakly (fun k => blowUp S y (ss k) (hss k).ne') C → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ConvergesWeakly (fun k => blowUp T (xs (φ k) + lams (φ k) • y) (lams (φ k) * ss k) (mul_pos (hlams (φ k)) (hss k)).ne') C
